comment: Variation of cry_sound-jellied-crocodile-egg-hatches-in-pack-valkyrie: sounds.c cry_sound() 647-649. A debug female Samurai rubs blessed royal jelly on a wished gargoyle egg (mon.c can_be_hatched() allows PM_GARGOYLE), then fights and searches until a gargoyle (MS_GRUNT) drops out of her pack: 'Its grunting sounds like "mommy."'
